description: Breadcrumbs recorded before an event accumulate in order and are attached to the next reported event. Each breadcrumb keeps its message and a type that defaults to 'default' when unspecified; an optional structured data object is preserved verbatim on the breadcrumb.

cases.expected_output:
url=https://sentry.io/api/123/store/
platform=c
message=message text
breadcrumb_count=2
breadcrumb[0].message=breadcrumb 1
breadcrumb[0].type=default
breadcrumb[1].message=breadcrumb 2
breadcrumb[1].type=navigation
breadcrumb[1].data={"from":"origin","to":"destination"}
event_id_length=32
last_event_id=0
